title: A walk keeps to its own field with an index
notes: `knows`, `fan` and `scout` share the LINK kind; a -fan-> t -scout-> b is not a `knows` walk. `a` is found by its own index and its walk searched from both ends, and still reaches nothing (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no chains or hop bands; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
